description: This Swift source file defines a singleton class 'KeychainStore' that provides secure storage and retrieval of string data in the iOS keychain. It includes methods for setting, getting, removing individual items, and clearing all stored entries for specific keys used in session management.

classes.name: KeychainStore
classes.description: A singleton class providing an interface to securely store, retrieve, and delete string values in the iOS Keychain. It manages keys such as accessToken, refreshToken, and accessTokenExpiry, facilitating secure session management.

methods.name: setString
methods.description: Stores a string value securely in the keychain associated with a specified key.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from the keychain for a specified key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific key-value pair from the keychain.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all session-related entries (access token, refresh token, expiry) from the keychain.
